'''December 2000 Fargo tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fargo, North Dakota on 9 December 2000. [[Josh Kohman]] won it. It is known from Jeff Kasper's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1520">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-fargo-nd-12-9-00d1520/ fargo-nd-12-9-00], DeckTech (jeff "kazper" kasper, 9 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-09-fargo-nd-12-9-00d1520/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Fargo, North Dakota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 27
* '''Winner:''' [[Josh Kohman]]
